```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run CI with Turbo
        run: pnpm turbo ci --filter=^!(ui|docs) --reporter=detailed --outputFile=./turbo-report.json

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: turbo-report
          path: ./turbo-report.json

      - name: Report failures
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "::error::Some tasks failed. Please check the details."
          cat ./turbo-report.json | jq '.failures[] | {task: .task, message: .message}'
```

Please note that you need to have `jq` installed in your environment to parse the JSON output and display errors. You can add a step to install `jq` if it's not already available:

```yaml
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
```
